name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
changes.summary: Lindell, of MyPillow, plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents. (Image credit: Dana Ferguson).

changes.title: Trump announces staff secretary Will Scharf, who helped secure ballroom approval, will be his new White House counsel
changes.summary: Democrats have vowed to pursue investigations into Trump and his administration if they are successful in November.

changes.title: Minnesota’s Democratic Senate Primary Pits Angie Craig Against Peggy Flanagan
changes.summary: The Senate primary race in Minnesota will be the latest test of left-wing energy in the party, in a state that was convulsed by the Trump administration’s deadly immigration crackdown this winter.

changes.title: Netanyahu Walks Tightrope on Trump’s Gaza Disarmament Deal
changes.summary: The Israeli prime minister, facing a tough upcoming election, is trying to satisfy the sometimes competing demands of his right-wing base and of President Trump.

changes.title: Trump signs order on childhood vaccination recommendations, citing autism
changes.summary: President Trump is signing an executive order on childhood vaccine schedules Monday.

changes.title: Trump order aims to cut number of diseases all children should be vaccinated against from 18 to 11
changes.summary: President Trump has issued an executive order reducing the number of recommended vaccines for children, reaffirming the overhaul that Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced earlier this year.

changes.title: RFK Jr. wants to fix loophole that allows additives into food. Critics say it doesn’t go far enough.
changes.summary: The Trump administration said it’s taking first steps in strengthening rules over ingredients food companies have long added to their products with minimal oversight.

changes.title: Trump and RFK Jr. try again to upend vaccines for kids
changes.summary: President Trump expected to sign executive order that once again tries to upend the vaccines children receive to protect them against measles, mumps, tetanus, whooping cough and other dangerous diseases. (Image credit: Jim Watson).

changes.title: Trump signs executive order on childhood vaccine recommendations
changes.summary: The order recommends separating the MMR vaccine into three different shots administered in separate visits, and directs the nation's health department to improve vaccine research, says a White House fact sheet.

changes.title: White House officials tamped down efforts to oust Max Miller in final days
changes.summary: Members of President Donald Trump’s political team asked Ohio Republicans last week not to wage a public pressure campaign against embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller, after they became increasingly convinced he wouldn't end his reelection bid. Their engagement, according to three people granted anonymity to share direct kno.
